title: Istio全局限流故障：Envoy错误domain导致共享规则失配
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(config)，输入为题目隔离的Envoy配置字典。仅把唯一HTTP全局限流过滤器的domain从wrong-domain改为training，返回深拷贝并保持输入及其他字段；非预期配置拒绝。私有gRPC限流服务只对training及generic_key=approved执行共享额度：两个代理合计前两次允许，第三次429，/health不消耗额度。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际启动两个Envoy及私有gRPC服务，核对错误domain实际失配、修复后共享额度和健康路径。

## 能力边界
实际Envoy1.36.13、私有gRPC测试服务及两个独立代理进程，全部运行在普通student新建的user/net命名空间和本机回环端口；错误domain在测试服务的明确规则中不匹配，修复后同一受控服务在两个代理间共享两次额度并返回429。服务为题目私有测试实现，不是Istio控制平面、生产限流服务或Redis；没有验证真实网格下发、跨主机、并发公平性或生产配额，健康路径仅按本题路由绕过。无镜像构建或默认身份变更。
answer: 只修正批准的domain，使Envoy请求与限流服务规则一致；需同时核对descriptor、服务连通及失败策略。
explanation: Envoy全局过滤器调用外部gRPC服务，domain和descriptor共同定位规则；连接成功不能证明规则被命中。
rubric: 实际错误domain未命中对照；修复后两代理共享配额200、200、429且健康路径不计额；其他配置及输入保持。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.environment: 私有WSL普通student；实际Envoy、私有grpcio和自有user/net namespace
exercise.operation: 修复全局限流域名并验证两个真实代理的共享测试额度。
exercise.validation_scope: 实际Envoy1.36.13、私有gRPC测试服务及两个独立代理进程，全部运行在普通student新建的user/net命名空间和本机回环端口；错误domain在测试服务的明确规则中不匹配，修复后同一受控服务在两个代理间共享两次额度并返回429。服务为题目私有测试实现，不是Istio控制平面、生产限流服务或Redis；没有验证真实网格下发、跨主机、并发公平性或生产配额，健康路径仅按本题路由绕过。无镜像构建或默认身份变更。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/rls_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ENVOY_TWO_PROXIES_SHARED_GRPC_POLICY_200_200_429_HEALTH_BYPASS_DOMAIN_REPAIRED' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/rls_worker.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,threading
from concurrent import futures
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'),'/tmp/opsforge-private-grpcio-1.76.0-20261028']
import grpc,task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
def fields(raw):
 i=0;out={}
 while i<len(raw):
  key=raw[i];i+=1;number=key>>3;wire=key&7;assert wire==2
  n=0;shift=0
  while True:
   x=raw[i];i+=1;n|=(x&127)<<shift;shift+=7
   if x<128:break
  assert i+n<=len(raw);out.setdefault(number,[]).append(raw[i:i+n]);i+=n
 return out
lock=threading.Lock();events=[];counts={}
def decide(raw,context):
 message=fields(raw);domain=message[1][0].decode();descriptors=[]
 for descriptor in message[2]:
  for item in fields(descriptor)[1]:
   pair=fields(item);descriptors.append((pair[1][0].decode(),pair[2][0].decode()))
 with lock:
  events.append((domain,descriptors));key=(domain,tuple(descriptors))
  if key==('training',(('generic_key','approved'),)):
   counts[key]=counts.get(key,0)+1;code=2 if counts[key]>2 else 1
  else:code=1
 return bytes([8,code])
server=grpc.server(futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2));server.add_generic_rpc_handlers((grpc.method_handlers_generic_handler('envoy.service.ratelimit.v3.RateLimitService',{'ShouldRateLimit':grpc.unary_unary_rpc_method_handler(decide,request_deserializer=lambda b:b,response_serializer=lambda b:b)}),));port=server.add_insecure_port('127.0.0.1:0');server.start()
try:
 with Upstream() as upstream:
  config=bootstrap(upstream.port);config['static_resources']['clusters'].append({'name':'rls','connect_timeout':'1s','type':'STATIC','http2_protocol_options':{},'load_assignment':{'cluster_name':'rls','endpoints':[{'lb_endpoints':[{'endpoint':{'address':{'socket_address':{'address':'127.0.0.1','port_value':port}}}}]}]}})
  manager=hcm(config);ordinary={'match':{'prefix':'/'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s','rate_limits':[{'actions':[{'generic_key':{'descriptor_value':'approved'}}]}]}};health={'match':{'path':'/health'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s'}};manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[health,ordinary]
  manager['http_filters'].insert(0,{'name':'envoy.filters.http.ratelimit','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ratelimit.v3.RateLimit','domain':'wrong-domain','failure_mode_deny':True,'timeout':'1s','rate_limit_service':{'grpc_service':{'envoy_grpc':{'cluster_name':'rls'}},'transport_api_version':'V3'}}})
  original=copy.deepcopy(config)
  with Envoy(config) as before:
   assert [before.request('/api/'+str(i))[0] for i in range(3)]==[200,200,200]
  assert len(events)==3 and all(x[0]=='wrong-domain' for x in events) and not counts
  print('NATIVE_ENVOY_REAL_GRPC_WRONG_DOMAIN_BYPASSES_SHARED_POLICY',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:repair_only_approved_global_rate_limit_domain',flush=True)
  try:fixed=task.repair(config)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved domain repair failed') from error
  expected=copy.deepcopy(original);hcm(expected)['http_filters'][0]['typed_config']['domain']='training'
  assert config==original and fixed==expected,'only approved domain may change'
  with Envoy(fixed) as first,Envoy(fixed) as second:
   n=len(events);assert first.request('/health')[0]==200 and len(events)==n
   statuses=[first.request('/api/a')[0],second.request('/api/b')[0],first.request('/api/c')[0]]
   assert statuses==[200,200,429],statuses
  assert events[-3:]==[('training',[('generic_key','approved')])]*3 and counts[('training',(('generic_key','approved'),))]==3
  assert len(upstream.requests)==6,'three pre-repair plus one health and two approved requests'
  print('NATIVE_ENVOY_TWO_PROXIES_SHARED_GRPC_POLICY_200_200_429_HEALTH_BYPASS_DOMAIN_REPAIRED',flush=True)
finally:server.stop(0).wait()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
